# Public preview — data and privacy notice

Live public HTTPS endpoint: https://sinan-mcp-public-preview.onrender.com/mcp
Read-only health check: https://sinan-mcp-public-preview.onrender.com/health


**SINAN MCP Public Preview** is independently developed open-source software and is not affiliated with, operated by, or endorsed by Brazil's Ministry of Health, DATASUS, SINAN, or OpenAI.

**Data shown:** Artificial, deterministic test fixtures only. The example `TUBE / 2024 / PI` contains 120 imaginary records generated by code. These are *not* confirmed SINAN notifications, TB cases, unique patients, an estimate of incidence, or real treatment outcomes.

**No patient-level data processing in the public deployment:** The public server does not load or query real SINAN datasets, does not connect to private databases, does not send local files to ChatGPT and does not have tools for writes, imports, arbitrary SQL, clinical profiling or model training.

**Access and processing:** People who connect the public MCP endpoint use their own MCP client (such as ChatGPT). Their requests to this endpoint are processed by the server and hosting provider and may be logged at infrastructure level (IP address, time, request metadata). The plugin operator should define a published retention/contact policy before wide release. Any exchanges with ChatGPT are additionally subject to the user's ChatGPT workspace and platform settings.

**Research distinction:** The private/local SINAN MCP variant may operate on publicly released health microdata under separate safeguards, institutional governance and disclosure review. That private variant is *not* exposed by this public preview.

**Clinical disclaimer:** No diagnosis, treatment recommendation, individual-level risk score, clinical decision support or official epidemiological statistic is produced by this preview.

**Source and security reports:** https://github.com/miscrapha-DELTA-IA/SINAN-MCP — report security concerns privately without attaching patient records, keys or sensitive logs.

## Catálogo de múltiplos agravos (v0.4.0a4, demonstração sintética implantada)

O catálogo possui referências e aliases internos para várias doenças e agravos, além de páginas de consulta oficiais. A presença de uma doença na busca não representa uma base carregada, um código oficial PySUS verificado ou estatísticas de notificação disponíveis. Só as ferramentas de demonstração de TB retornam contagens **totalmente fictícias**. A coleta de tabelas reais exige uma cadeia separada de validação científica, documentação de proveniência, proteção estatística e aprovação independente antes da publicação.

## Operational safeguards and current limits

Per-process request throttling (300 MCP requests/minute, up to 16 concurrent MCP requests) was deployed to the public Render demonstration on 2026-11-04. It is **global to one process**, not a per-user protection or defense against distributed attacks. HTTPS post-deployment smoke testing verified a 10-tool synthetic-only contract, not scientific validity or data privacy certification. Retention, provider-edge controls and alert thresholds in [SECURITY_OPERATIONS.md](SECURITY_OPERATIONS.md) remain proposed or unverified. The [scheduled smoke check](../.github/workflows/public-live-smoke.yml) is read-only and cannot guarantee continuous availability.
